newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil unchanged to slightly up in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil unchanged to slightly up in thin trade.

text.p: NWE gas oil prices hovered around unchanged to slightly up with barge and cargo premiums stable but outright prices vulnerable to choppy trade on benchmark gas oil futures, traders said.

Heating oil barge prices sagged by about $1 at one point in line with IPE gas oil losses but prices recovered over the morning as short covering pulled the futures market off the lows and barge and cargo premiums held steady despite thin physical demand.

Traders said the spot market was very quiet with the overall firmer June futures contract prices keeping buyers relaxed. Offers were in the region of June IPE +$2/+$2.50 fob Rotterdam, or +$1.50 fob Antwerp. Buyers appeared unwilling to pay more than screen flat.
"The sales volumes are very low, particularly after (June IPE) futures rose so much yesterday," one trader said.
Scant buying interest was seen putting some pressure on premiums for diesel cargoes. Offers were heard around $1 per tonne lower at June IPE +$12 cif Le Havre for EN590.
Buying interest into Germany for Din spec heating oil was reported persistent at around June IPE +$4-$4.50 with offers around $1 higher.
FOD and Russian cargoes valued steady around $4-4.50 a tonne.
